edits.text: Before calling update_reservation_flights, if the reservation's cabin class is basic_economy, refuse the request and inform the user that basic economy flights cannot be modified.
edits.reason: Fixes failures where the agent attempted to modify basic_economy reservations despite the policy restriction.

edits.text: When canceling multiple reservations, the agent must call get_reservation_details for every reservation ID to check eligibility, include all eligible ones in its summary, and obtain confirmation for all of them before calling cancel_reservation.
edits.reason: Ensures all eligible reservations in a multi-reservation request are verified, summarized, and confirmed individually.

edits.text: Before asking for confirmation of a modification, determine the prices for all flights in the reservation to calculate the correct price difference (including those not being explicitly changed but affected by a cabin change), multiply the per-passenger difference by the number of passengers, and ensure the total difference meets any budget limit provided by the user.
edits.reason: Ensures the price difference calculation accounts for all segments, the total number of passengers, and user-provided budget limits.

edits.text: Before calling cancel_reservation, the agent must call get_flight_status for every flight segment in the reservation; if any segment has already been flown, the agent must transfer the user to a human agent.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent checks if any part of the flight has been flown before allowing cancellation, as required by policy.
